notes.title: Open beta is live now
notes.content:
Hello,

We want to build the game alongside our community, so we are opening the playtests for everyone.

Please fill our [url=https://forms.gle/ufivFxWsXF7Ht7Ny8]survey[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/29gqKXCNsV]Discord[/url] to share your feedback with us !

Fixes :
fix Power brew name not showing
fix energy surge tile giving only 1 energy

Spells :
change Lightning armor tooltip
Berserk strike : now loses 0 hp when raging
Vampiric strike : now create more Vampiric Orb when Raging
Energy surge : now gives 3 base energy and 3 more when played fast

Relics :
removing Lifedrinker for now

Misc :
title screen rework

Enemies :
Knight "Weaken attack" : 
- doesn't add an attack anymore
- can now be disable by "Disable Upgrade"
minor change to Knight attacks sequence
Bat HP are now balanced after Act I

Cheers
Ustu games
